purpose: Prevent future Prometeo work from rebuilding worker orchestration that is already durable, tested or ratcheted. RUN packets are bounded experiments; ordinary useful capacity returns to CURRENT Work Graph/portfolio through POOL.

laws.rule: Use RUN only for a bounded frozen experiment/fixture with explicit slots/gates. Do not grow RUN packets into the general scheduler.
For ongoing generic capacity use POOL. No expected-count barrier; workers re-enter the compact frontier after productive returns.
3 productive units is checkpoint, target 6, hard cap 8 unless a real boundary/exhaustion stops the chat.
POOL/BATCH workers stable-filter definitively incompatible candidates, then shard deterministically from beacon_commit_sha; atomic CREATE remains authority.
Do not wait for a slow cohort tail. Rolling pool evaluation does not pause useful capacity.
Generic and specialized capacity are distinguished centrally; worker does not discover capability fit through project archaeology.
A counted return normally leads to reallocation in the same chat; one completed unit is not terminal.
A concrete grounded residual may become at most one bounded successor when a chat must stop. No filler successors.
Integrate returns before inventing unrelated work; planner/rescate/critic roles self-materialize deterministically from durable evidence; same worker may consume successor.
Durable work survives chat death; generation fencing rejects stale results; fresh shells continue without human recap.

Before terminal close, reuse the existing E9 exam as the one worker-exit audit owner. Record observable decision trace, durable timing, tool/connector use, friction categories, residual debt and bounded improvement candidates. Never expose hidden chain-of-thought and never create a parallel telemetry truth source.
ACTIVE/PARKED labels never prove a shell is alive. Keep durable work/recovery state, not imaginary resident chat liveness. Do not create busywork or polling just to keep workers 'active'.
V3_EVIDENCE_MAP remains baseline; DONE and PASS remain distinct.

forbidden: turning fixed RUN slots into permanent routing
waiting for all workers before useful reallocation in POOL mode
raw heartbeat/event growth as a substitute for useful work
truth_boundary: This contract preserves/reuses existing worker mechanisms. It grants no new product authority and changes no CURRENT pointer.
